outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic/diagram showing timing bars (camera exposure time vs illumination overhead) with percentage values annotated, not a bar chart of averaged replicate data requiring individual points.
Panel B is a line plot (photobleaching decay curves over frame number) with shaded s.e.m.; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlay.
Panel C is a scatter/line plot (ΔROS vs exposure time with a fitted curve); scatter plots inherently show individual points, no overlay needed.
Panel D shows individual migration tracks as lines, one per cell, which are themselves the individual data points/trajectories.
Panel E is a bar chart of mean±s.e.m. migration speed with individual data points (dots) overlaid for each cell.
Panel F consists of micrographs (Mitotracker/Paxillin/Merge images), not a quantitative plot of averaged data.
Panel G is a time-lapse micrograph series, not a plot.
Panel H is a time-lapse micrograph series, not a plot.
Panel I is a line plot (normalized cell area over time, mean±s.e.m., n=5); line plots are exempt from requiring individual point overlay.
Panel J is a line plot (normalized mitochondrial area over time, mean±s.e.m., n=5); line plots are exempt from requiring individual point overlay.
